lines.zh: 四条短腿在泥里走，声音很轻
lines.en: Four short legs in the mud, very quiet
I walk like a foraging pig
My snout is almost touching the ground
I go around the mud pits, too conspicuous
The village has a pen, I know it well
I sniff all the way, but not for food
My hooves crunch the dry straw

lines.zh: 走得太直了，猪不会这样
lines.en: Too straight a line, pigs do not walk like that

lines.zh: 猪鼻子里发出不属于猪的声音。
lines.en: A sound not a pig's comes from my snout.

lines.zh: 身上的味儿不太对，我压低些
lines.en: The smell is off, I keep low
My tail curls and keeps twitching

lines.zh: 我一边走一边听着脚步
lines.en: I walk and listen for footsteps
I stand by the mud but do not go in
My snout twitches twice
The other pigs squeal, I do not
The fur on this hide looks fake
Standing still is the hardest part

lines.zh: 泥土沾在蹄上，味道盖住了
lines.en: Mud on my hooves masks the smell
I wait until someone is alone

lines.zh: 耳朵朝一个方向，很久不动
lines.en: My ear points one way and stays
I chew on a grass root

lines.zh: 我盯着食槽，不是因为饿
lines.en: I stare at the trough, not from hunger

lines.zh: 你手里有空碗，是来喂的
lines.en: You have an empty bowl, you came to feed

lines.zh: 我抬头，猪很少这样抬头
lines.en: I look up, pigs rarely look up
Have you smelled this hide of mine
My snout is wet, my eyes are not
Do not put your hand near my mouth

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，是开着的吗
lines.en: Is that door behind you open
I have followed you the whole way

lines.zh: 你退后的时候，踩到了泥
lines.en: You stepped in the mud as you backed off

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神，你该明白
lines.en: The way I look at you, you should understand

lines.zh: 这一圈猪里，只有我站得直
lines.en: In this pen, only I stand straight
I let out a long grunt

lines.zh: 皮破了一道，露出里面的颜色
lines.en: The hide split, and the color inside shows

lines.zh: 我滚进泥里，把伤口糊住
lines.en: I rolled in the mud to cover the wound
I have remembered this
I lower my head and circle half a turn
In pain, I cannot keep up the act
I lean on the rail and stand

lines.zh: 泥糊在身上，血看不出来
lines.en: Mud on me hides the blood

lines.zh: 这一身皮，比你想象的薄
lines.en: This hide is thinner than you think
I did not squeal like a pig
You try to lure me with scraps
I root at it twice and do not eat
This smell is for people
I pretend to eat and watch you

lines.zh: 你手放低一点，我够得着
lines.en: Lower your hand and I can reach
Pigs eat this, I do not
It smells fine, a pity I am not hungry
What do you want in exchange for food
I tipped the bowl over
The way you crouch is just right

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我先哼了一声
lines.en: You bumped me and I grunted first
Four legs hold steady, and I am thick
That splash came up from the mud

lines.zh: 我往边上让，让得有点多
lines.en: I gave way, and gave rather too much
Do not come from behind, my tail moves
You hit my shoulder
I backed to the rail, no way out

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的腿
lines.en: I have your legs noted now
A pig would not give way so neatly
Bump me again and I turn around
I have seen what happens in the pen
This hide will not come off
Will you root in the dirt with me
This grunt of mine is learned
The other pigs keep away
I know you are testing me
I will pretend I did not hear that
I lower my head and root up some mud
Pretending this long does get tiring
Walk away, do not get tangled in this
I nudge it with my snout
This has no smell
I bite it and chew
I cannot chew it, so I spit it out
I press it under a hoof and grind it
I do not pick it up, pigs do
You pick it up, and I watch
It rolled into the trough
I root it into the corner
It fell in the mud, perfect
I have caught your scent
Sixty paces, I counted
I lift my head, the act is done
You are walking that way alone

lines.zh: 蹄子在泥里转了个方向
lines.en: My hooves turn in the mud
There is nothing else alive here
I do not shout, I do not squeal

lines.zh: 我照着你留下的脚印走
lines.en: I follow the prints you left

lines.zh: 你听见的哼声，离你越来越近
lines.en: The grunt you hear is getting closer
This hide will not hold much longer
I see your hand going for the knife
The whole pen has cleared aside
You moved first, do not blame me
This time I have settled on you
The door behind you has closed

lines.zh: 我走到这一步，就不会退
lines.en: Having come this far, I will not turn back
I follow you, exactly one step behind
Climb the wall, I can climb it too

lines.zh: 六十步不算远，我慢慢来
lines.en: Sixty paces is not much, I take my time

lines.zh: 你往回走，就是往我这边来
lines.en: You walk back, which is toward me
I am as near as your heel
You turn a corner, I take the short way

lines.zh: 这村子的小巷，我都走过
lines.en: I have walked every alley in this village
You should not head for the pen
I wait outside the fence for you

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得出
lines.en: Your steps have broken rhythm, I can hear

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，声音很轻
lines.en: I keep low and my steps are light
I know this stretch very well

lines.zh: 你开始跑了，可前面是死巷
lines.en: You are running now, but that is a dead end

lines.zh: 我一直没叫，所以你没听见
lines.en: I never called out, which is why you heard nothing
One more corner and we meet
My snout stays on your trail
Your sweat is getting stronger
I have this one won

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根一路跟，墙上没有缝
lines.en: I track you along the wall, and the wall has no gaps

lines.zh: 你在院子里，我就在门边
lines.en: You are in the yard, and I am at the door
I ram your legs with my head
The teeth are not sharp, but the bite is tight
I lunge, far quicker than a pig
A claw comes out from under the hide
You are knocked into the mud

lines.zh: 这一下，几乎撕开了你的衣服
lines.en: That nearly tore your clothes open
I swing my head and you go down
You might block the first
I press down on you, very heavy
A hoof comes down on your wrist
You back off, and I do not chase far
Blood on my mouth will not rub off
You can hear the hide splitting

lines.zh: 这一声哼，和刚才的不一样
lines.en: That grunt is not like the earlier ones
You are up again, how troublesome
The next bite will not miss

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的靴子上
lines.en: I bite down on your boot

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，让你跪下来
lines.en: I butt your knee to bring you down
I press down with my whole body
There is one more by the pen
I rise up from beside the haystack
I squeeze in among the other pigs

lines.zh: 栏里的猪往边上看了一眼
lines.en: The pigs in the pen glanced sideways
One pig nobody put there
I stop by the trough
The mud on me was just smeared on
I land squarely on four legs
In the herd, I stand straightest
I root the haystack aside and come out

lines.zh: 我抬了一下鼻子，闻到了
lines.en: I lift my snout, I caught it
The fur shrank back as it burned

lines.zh: 落地那一下，四条腿都震了
lines.en: On landing, all four legs jarred
Muddy water is worse than clean
The blast rolled me several turns
An arrow is stuck in my back

lines.zh: 那股力气把我的皮照透了
lines.en: That force showed right through the hide
I have gone hungry in this pen too long
At the flash, the whole pen panicked
No mud underfoot, my hooves find nothing
